text: Read the plaque ahead, then take the door on the left: Room 1, the Triangle.
Welcome. Read the plaque on the far wall: you can read it from here.
Then take the door on your left, into the Triangle room.
Find the one spot where the triangle closes.
Somewhere in here is a triangle that shouldn't exist.
Read the plaque on the wall to your right, then explore. As you get close, a tone rises and the ring round the crosshair glows.
Hint: a ring of light has appeared on the floor, on your left as you come in from the hall, about six steps in, under a glowing column. Stand in it and look at the triangle.
Stand inside the ring of light under the glowing column, left of the hall door, and face the triangle.
Walk sideways and watch it break. Then the Machine, through the hall's right-hand door.
There: three beams closing into a loop. Now take a few steps sideways and watch it.
The Machine, through the hall's right-hand door.
One loop found. Next is the Machine, through the hall's right-hand door.
Turn MI into MU, using only the buttons.
A machine that changes words. The rules are on the wall, the buttons on the desk.
Look at a button and press it to apply its rule. Try to turn MI into MU.

You've been working inside the machine's rules. The gate has opened: it's at the foot of the ramp, in the corner on your right as you come in. Follow the lights up and look at the machine from outside.
Climb the ramp to the balcony and read the board.
That's how it works. Keep going: can you reach MU?
